expectedRealization.rationale: Rare-earth price/volume can flow into earnings quickly, but the 60d rerating and supply response make the base horizon an expectation-absorption test.

changeHypothesis.summary: Rare-earth prices surged on magnet demand and Myanmar/inspection risks, but domestic quotas were raised sharply and high prices encouraged new supply. 盛和 had already published a high-growth 2021-22 earnings path and the stock had moved from a huge 60d rerating into 20d relative weakness.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Demand growth is structural, but supply quotas and global projects can shorten the scarcity premium.
disconfirmingEvidence: H1 rare-earth quotas were raised about 27%.
The stock was late_reversal after very large 60d outperformance.
The Feb forecast already expected 2021 profit to nearly quadruple from 2020E.

causalChain.mechanism: EV/wind demand plus Myanmar/inspection risks tighten near-term supply.
Higher rare-earth prices and business scale lift revenue/profit.
causalChain.failureMode: price normalization or inventory effects compress margins

causalChain.mechanism: Alpha requires upside beyond a baseline already forecasting very large 2021-22 profit growth after a major stock rerating.
causalChain.failureMode: good earnings merely confirm an already-capitalized scarcity cycle
